title: Management Group hierarchy audit
description: Validates the MG hierarchy structure, finding misplaced subscriptions or empty management groups.
example_prompt: "Show the full Management Group hierarchy tree. For each MG, show: child subscription count, policies assigned, and RBAC roles. Flag: (1) empty MGs with no children, (2) subscriptions directly under root MG, (3) MGs with conflicting policies compared to parent."
